entrypoints.summary: An unauthenticated GraphQL caller submits ciCatalogResources(search: ...) and requests versions.nodes.readme and readmeHtml.
The vendor validation plan exercises the plural /api/graphql catalog query before and after disabling the project repository feature.

affected_components.role: Field resolvers for repository-derived catalog version README content.
Request-level regression oracle for null README fields when repository access is disabled.

code_slices.fixed: readme and readme_html resolution returns no value unless Ability.allowed?(current_user, :read_code, object.project) succeeds.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The request regression configures a public project with repository, merge-request, and build access disabled, queries ciCatalogResources, and expects readme/readmeHtml to be nil.
code_slices.vulnerable: The vendor MR describes plural ciCatalogResources exposing README content where the repository feature is disabled; the patch shows the required read_code early returns inserted into the readme and readme_html resolver paths.

negative_controls: REST repository access returns 403 in the reported setup.
The singular ciCatalogResource GraphQL query blocks access in the reported setup.
After remediation, the plural query yields null for readme and readmeHtml.
observability.positive_marker: Before remediation, returned readme or readmeHtml content from the disabled-repository project.

preconditions: A qualifying public project has a README, CI component, and published CI Catalog version.
Repository access is disabled for the project while catalog-resource results remain available.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: GraphQL query with ciCatalogResources(search: project identifier) and nested readme/readmeHtml selections.
trigger_steps.summary: Submit an unauthenticated ciCatalogResources GraphQL search requesting versions.nodes.readme and readmeHtml.

capabilities.concept: bypass repository-feature access restriction for README fields

impacts.concept: unauthorized disclosure of repository README documentation

mitigations.concept: read_code guard in catalog-version README field resolvers

relation_candidates.rationale: The reported plural query returns readme/readmeHtml despite disabled repository access and does not apply the read_code check required by the fixed resolvers.

relation_candidates.dst: bypass repository-feature access restriction for README fields
relation_candidates.rationale: Reading README fields without the project read_code capability bypasses the repository-feature restriction for those specific fields.

relation_candidates.dst: unauthorized disclosure of repository README documentation
relation_candidates.rationale: The disclosure report states that the query retrieves README content from projects with disabled repository access.

relation_candidates.dst: read_code guard in catalog-version README field resolvers
relation_candidates.rationale: The patch makes both README resolvers return no value unless current_user has read_code on object.project.

impact.affected_asset: Repository-derived README documentation, including any sensitive information stored in those README files.
impact.attacker_capability: An unauthenticated remote caller can retrieve the exposed README fields through the plural catalog GraphQL query.
impact.security_effect: Unauthorized disclosure of README and rendered README content from public CI Catalog projects whose repository feature was disabled.

causal_trace.summary: A public project is configured as a CI/CD Catalog project with a README and a published catalog version, then repository, build, and merge-request features are disabled.

The plural ciCatalogResources path exposed repository-derived README fields based on catalog visibility without requiring read_code for the version project; the report contrasts this with REST and singular GraphQL paths that blocked access.

CiCatalogResourceVersion README resolution returns or renders object.readme on the plural-query result path without the required read_code authorization gate; the fix adds an early permission return in both readme and readme_html resolvers.
The caller receives README or rendered README content although repository access is disabled, disclosing documentation contained in qualifying public catalog projects.

failure.operation: Resolve catalog-version readme/readmeHtml from object.readme without first rejecting callers lacking read_code on object.project.

primary_invariant.statement: Repository-derived readme and readmeHtml fields on a catalog version must require read_code on that version's project regardless of the GraphQL query path.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The plural catalog query reached the version fields without enforcing read_code, even when the project repository feature was disabled.

quality.review_notes: The public imported disclosure provides a concrete unauthenticated trigger and observed disclosure, while the immutable fix diff directly shows guards for both resolver paths. Regression artifacts specify the intended positive and negative oracle but do not contain a test-run result. Available evidence bounds impact to readme/readmeHtml disclosure; it does not establish arbitrary repository-file access or a complete affected-release range.

remediation.invariant_restored: Both readme and readme_html resolvers return no value unless Ability.allowed?(current_user, :read_code, object.project) is true.
mitigation_classes: consistent authorization across GraphQL query paths

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The report describes a public project with README and CI component, a tag/release that creates a catalog version, and disabled repository, builds, and merge-request features.
data_structure_invariants: A catalog version's README fields are derived from its project repository content.
A caller lacking read_code on the version project must not receive readme or readmeHtml, independent of whether a singular or plural GraphQL query reaches the version.
state_context.state_machine: A public project is published as a CI Catalog resource/version, then its repository-related features are disabled while catalog results remain queryable.

target.component: CI Catalog GraphQL CiCatalogResourceVersion README field resolvers

oracle.expected_negative: With the repository feature disabled and no read_code permission, plural ciCatalogResources results have null readme and readmeHtml fields while the resource/version remains present.
oracle.expected_positive: With read_code or an enabled repository, README remains a resolvable field for catalog versions.
